recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for core FHIR. If the external OO incubator SupplyRequest artifact lacks the same workflow request note, handle that in the owning external specification rather than in this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-10294 is a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking that DeviceUseRequest, DiagnosticRequest, NutritionRequest, and Supply request-resource introductions state that the resource is a FHIR workflow request resource and link to workflow.html#request.
initial_application: Commit ba3dfa8e35e225367db61b239aa1c9248554262e initially added request workflow notes to DeviceUseRequest, DiagnosticRequest, NutritionRequest, and SupplyRequest introductions. The DiagnosticRequest note flowed into the ProcedureRequest/ServiceRequest lineage, while later edits removed the note from DeviceRequest and NutritionOrder.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps DeviceRequest, NutritionOrder, and ServiceRequest in the core build. SupplyRequest was removed from the active core resource list by 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32, and current workflow pages point to an external OO incubator SupplyRequest artifact. Later R6 ballot-note commits ce624b1f8585e65e2fad37fd99882e2099a2aa41 and 157f87ddfb7a8ca4f6f0387a8e8f6cdaaf93c7ea removed the previously applied request workflow paragraphs from DeviceRequest and NutritionOrder.
reconciliation: Added request-resource notes with workflow.html#request links to DeviceRequest and NutritionOrder introductions, and updated the retained ServiceRequest note to link directly to the request workflow anchor. The stale local SupplyRequest source directory was not edited because it is outside current core build scope.
source_changes: source/devicerequest/devicerequest-introduction.xml: restored the FHIR workflow request-resource note and workflow.html#request link.
source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-introduction.xml: restored the FHIR workflow request-resource note and workflow.html#request link.
source/servicerequest/servicerequest-introduction.xml: updated the existing request-resource note to link directly to workflow.html#request.
source/supplyrequest/supplyrequest-introduction.xml: intentionally unchanged because SupplyRequest is no longer an active core build resource.
